prompts.today:
Generate one standalone desk illustration asset, based on the mascot and composition in the LEFTMOST PHONE of the reference. The reference is character/composition guidance only; the required rendering style is RETRO SILKSCREEN PRINTED POSTER + HAND-DRAWN FLAT ILLUSTRATION.
Think mid-century screen-printed children's-book poster. VISUALLY FLAT: large simplified solid ink shapes; only five muted spot inks (olive green, deep forest/brown-black, terracotta, butter yellow, dusty blue-gray) plus warm unprinted cream. Clean hand-drawn irregular contours, restrained single-weight dark outlines. Light sparse paper-fiber pinholes within the ink, subtle 1–2 pixel misregistration at a few color edges. Texture is subordinate to graphic flat shapes. NO dense white stippling, NO photographic grain.
Liuli character: short, compact round olive durian silhouette with small angular spikes, short brown rectangular stem, pale butter-yellow round face, tiny dot eyes, little curved smile and blush dots, two simple small hands. Match the reference mascot proportions. It is writing in an open cream notebook at a terracotta desk. Left: simple flat potted leafy plant. Right: small cream mug with green heart and a rectangular olive-framed window showing a flat sun and city silhouettes. Window is rectangular, not arched. Simplify all objects into bold poster shapes.
Horizontal 3:2 composition; a single connected scene, all objects visible. Real transparent alpha outside the artwork; crisp irregular silhouette edges, minimal scattered print flecks. No colored haze, glow, blur, ambient shadow or fade outside the objects. No gradients, lighting, realistic volume, watercolor washes, gouache brush shading, 3D, glossy effects, soft focus. No text, labels, UI, phone, watermark. The output must read as a FLAT SCREEN-PRINT illustration, not a painted rendering.
